# Assembler aliases

[← dictionary index](index.md)

A mnemonic that assembles to another instruction (`FNEG` and `FABS` with the mark `.32` on the source register to an instruction with an operand of their own, and a `MOVQ` before it when the registers differ; `ROL` to `ROR` with the count complemented) or to a short fixed sequence of instructions (`ABS`, `MIN`, `MINU`, `MAX` and `MAXU`, which write the scratch register `R12`). One mnemonic is one instruction (section 9.18); the disassembler never prints an alias.

*Generated by `tools/mkmanual.py` from `spec/grammars.d`; do not edit.*

| Written | Assembles to | Group |
|---|---|---|
| `FNEG` with `.32` on the source | `XOR` with the operand `#-2147483648` (after `MOVQ Rs, Rd` if the registers differ) | `alu` |
| `FABS` with `.32` on the source | `AND` with the operand `#0x7FFFFFFF` (after `MOVQ Rs, Rd` if the registers differ) | `alu` |
| `ABS` | the sequence `MOVQ Rs, R12`, `SAR #63, R12`, `MOVQ Rs, Rd` (left out when `Rd` is `Rs`), `XOR R12, Rd`, `SUB R12, Rd` | `alu` |
| `CBHIS` | `CBCC` | `cbranch` |
| `CBLO` | `CBCS` | `cbranch` |
| `MAX` | the sequence `SETGT Ra, Rb, R12`, `NEG R12`, `BSEL R12, Ra, Rb, Rd` | `ext` |
| `MAXU` | the sequence `SETHI Ra, Rb, R12`, `NEG R12`, `BSEL R12, Ra, Rb, Rd` | `ext` |
| `MIN` | the sequence `SETLT Ra, Rb, R12`, `NEG R12`, `BSEL R12, Ra, Rb, Rd` | `ext` |
| `MINU` | the sequence `SETLO Ra, Rb, R12`, `NEG R12`, `BSEL R12, Ra, Rb, Rd` | `ext` |
| `MULU` | `MUL` | `alu` |
| `ROL` | `ROR` with the count `#n` complemented to `#(64-n)` (a constant count only) | `besc` |
